verdict: Ranked on four measured facts, no buy call. Cheapest to finish: Surging Sparks $1,177.88 (sum of 30d sold medians, 249/252 cards, Oct 4 mark), Mega Evolution $1,488.58 (185/188, Oct 4). Cheapest sealed: Mega Evolution ETB lowest ask $118.99 (18 clean, Oct 6) vs Surging Sparks $119.00 (10). Deepest chase: Evolving Skies 13 cards at $100+. Most liquid: 30th Celebration 191/191 cards with 10+ sales/30d. Hardest start: 151 (153/207 liquid, 3 clean ETB listings, low $560.99). Celebrations left out: its Charizard 4/102 tape mixes in 30th-Celebration reprint titles.
